name: Marine 27 L V12
notes: Card D2. A medium-speed marine V12 within the model's limits: 27 L (137 x 152 mm, 15:1, a turbo a bank), a mechanical governor with 5 % droop, rated 1800 rpm. The model holds at most 30 L and 16 cylinders, a diesel's redline some 13.5 m/s of piston speed, an idle no lower than 350 rpm: a 1000 rpm locomotive's or ship's medium-speed engine of 100 to 200 L is past it. On the bench. Air at 300 K, 101325 Pa. Its valves (25 Nov): the tractor archetype's events, that archetype's judgement; no cam card found. Before, the reference's cam dial at 0.9999 (300 deg on a lobe separation of 106: 88 deg of overlap), which under a turbine's back pressure blows the exhaust back into the intake (card D2's truck fixture, N2's truck-valve-events.md). Its idle trim -400 -> -50: the ECU raised a 0.9999 cam's idle by 350 rpm (idle.fm), which the old trim took back.
